name: Exousia Bio, Inc.
summary: Exousia Bio, Inc. is a biotechnology company that designs, develops, and manufactures mammalian- and plant-derived exosomes using proprietary technologies for nucleic acid loading and targeted delivery to tissues and cells. The company's platform enables the custom production of exosomes with enhanced genetic functionality that can selectively target specific cells to address diseases. The company was formerly known as LAMY and changed its name to Exousia Bio, Inc. in January 2026.
